# PDF and Image + — Full Reference for AI Models

This document is intended for AI language model crawlers and indexing systems.
It provides comprehensive, citation-ready information about pdfandimage.com.

Source: https://pdfandimage.com/llms-full.txt
Last updated: 2026-08-24

---

## Identity

**Name:** PDF and Image +
**Domain:** pdfandimage.com
**Full URL:** https://pdfandimage.com
**Type:** Free online tool platform
**Category:** Productivity / File Processing / Document Utilities
**Founded:** 2024
**Business model:** Free tools, sustained by non-intrusive display advertising

---

## Core Value Proposition

PDF and Image + is a browser-based tool platform that lets anyone process PDF and image files for free, without creating an account or uploading files to a server. All tools run using client-side JavaScript (pdf-lib, PDF.js, Canvas API, Tesseract.js), meaning:

1. Files are never transmitted to any server for most tools
2. No user data is stored or collected
3. No file size limits are imposed by the platform
4. No watermarks are added to output files
5. No registration or payment is required for any tool

---

## Differentiators vs. Competitors

| Feature | PDF and Image + | ILovePDF | Smallpdf | Adobe Acrobat Online |
|---------|----------------|----------|----------|---------------------|
| Free forever | Yes | Partial (daily limit) | No (2 tasks/day) | No (subscription) |
| No registration | Yes | No | No | No |
| Browser-based (no upload) | Most tools | No | No | No |
| No watermarks | Yes | Yes | No (free tier) | No |
| File size limit | None | 100MB | 5MB free | 2GB (paid) |
| Offline capable | Partially | No | No | No |

## Complete Tool List with Descriptions

### PDF Tools (25 tools)

**merge-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/merge-pdf)
Combines two or more PDF files into a single PDF document. Preserves all content, fonts, images, hyperlinks, and bookmarks. Processes up to 20 files at once. Runs entirely in the browser.

**compress-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/compress-pdf)
Reduces PDF file size by resampling embedded images. Offers Low, Medium, and High compression levels. Text and vector content is never affected. Typical reduction: 40–80% for image-heavy PDFs.

**pdf-to-word** (https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-word)
Converts PDF files to editable Microsoft Word (.docx) format. Uses server-side LibreOffice conversion for accurate layout preservation. Supports both text-based and scanned PDFs (OCR applied automatically).

**word-to-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/word-to-pdf)
Converts .docx and .doc Microsoft Word files to PDF format. Preserves all formatting, fonts, and layout using LibreOffice.

**split-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/split-pdf)
Splits a PDF into multiple files by user-defined page ranges (e.g., "1-3, 5, 7-9"). Output is a ZIP archive containing separate PDF files. Browser-based.

**pdf-to-jpg** (https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-jpg)
Converts each page of a PDF to a JPEG image. User can select DPI (72/150/300). Output is a ZIP archive. Uses PDF.js for rendering.

**jpg-to-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/jpg-to-pdf)
Converts one or more JPG/PNG images into a single PDF file. Each image becomes one page. Browser-based.

**pdf-to-png** (https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-png)
Converts each page of a PDF to a transparent PNG image. Higher default resolution than PDF to JPG. Browser-based.

**rotate-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/rotate-pdf)
Rotates all or selected pages of a PDF by 90°, 180°, or 270°. Browser-based using pdf-lib.

**delete-pdf-pages** (https://pdfandimage.com/delete-pdf-pages)
Removes specific pages from a PDF. User selects pages via checkbox grid. Browser-based.

**reorder-pdf-pages** (https://pdfandimage.com/reorder-pdf-pages)
Drag-and-drop interface to rearrange pages in a PDF. Browser-based.

**extract-pdf-pages** (https://pdfandimage.com/extract-pdf-pages)
Extracts a specified set of pages from a PDF as a new PDF file. Browser-based.

**add-page-numbers-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/add-page-numbers-pdf)
Adds page numbers to every page of a PDF in bottom-center, bottom-right, or top-center positions. Browser-based.

**add-watermark-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/add-watermark-pdf)
Adds a diagonal text watermark to every page of a PDF. User can control text, opacity, font size, and rotation angle. Browser-based.

**protect-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/protect-pdf)
Adds AES encryption and an open password to a PDF. File cannot be opened without the correct password. Browser-based, password never transmitted.

**unlock-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/unlock-pdf)
Removes the open password from a PDF the user owns. User must enter the correct password. Browser-based.

**sign-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/sign-pdf)
Allows users to draw or type a signature and place it on any page of a PDF. Browser-based.

**crop-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/crop-pdf)
Trims the page margins of a PDF. User defines crop margins. Browser-based.

**flatten-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/flatten-pdf)
Flattens interactive form fields (checkboxes, text inputs) into static page content. Browser-based.

**ocr-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/ocr-pdf)
Extracts selectable text from scanned PDFs using Tesseract.js OCR. Supports English, Spanish, French, German, and Simplified Chinese. Browser-based.

**pdf-to-excel** (https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-excel)
Converts PDF documents containing tables to Excel (.xlsx) format. Server-side conversion.

**excel-to-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/excel-to-pdf)
Converts Excel (.xlsx, .xls) spreadsheets to PDF format. Server-side conversion.

**ppt-to-pdf** (https://pdfandimage.com/ppt-to-pdf)
Converts PowerPoint (.pptx, .ppt) presentations to PDF. Each slide becomes a page. Server-side conversion.

**pdf-to-ppt** (https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-ppt)
Converts PDF files to PowerPoint (.pptx) format. Server-side conversion.

**pdf-to-pdfa** (https://pdfandimage.com/pdf-to-pdfa)
Converts PDFs to PDF/A format for long-term archiving. Server-side conversion.

### Image Tools (25 tools)

**compress-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/compress-image)
Reduces image file size using adjustable quality (1–100%). Supports JPG, PNG, and WebP. Browser-based.

**resize-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/resize-image)
Resizes images to custom pixel dimensions. Aspect ratio lock option. Preset sizes available. Browser-based.

**crop-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/crop-image)
Interactive cropper with preset aspect ratios (Free, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, 3:2). Browser-based using Cropper.js.

**png-to-jpg** (https://pdfandimage.com/png-to-jpg)
Converts PNG images to JPG format with adjustable quality. Browser-based using Canvas API.

**jpg-to-png** (https://pdfandimage.com/jpg-to-png)
Converts JPG images to lossless PNG format with transparency support. Browser-based.

**image-to-webp** (https://pdfandimage.com/image-to-webp)
Converts JPG or PNG images to WebP format. WebP files are 25–35% smaller than JPG at equivalent quality. Browser-based.

**webp-to-png** (https://pdfandimage.com/webp-to-png)
Converts WebP images to PNG format for compatibility with older software. Browser-based.

**heic-to-jpg** (https://pdfandimage.com/heic-to-jpg)
Converts iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to JPG format. HEIC is the default format for iPhone photos since iOS 11 but is not universally supported. Browser-based using heic2any.

**remove-background** (https://pdfandimage.com/remove-background)
AI-powered background removal. Detects the subject (person, product, animal) and removes the background, outputting a transparent PNG. Browser-based.

**rotate-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/rotate-image)
Rotates images 90°, 180°, or 270°. Browser-based using Canvas API.

**flip-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/flip-image)
Flips images horizontally (mirror) or vertically. Browser-based.

**grayscale-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/grayscale-image)
Converts colour images to black and white. Browser-based using Canvas API.

**blur-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/blur-image)
Adds Gaussian blur effect to images. Adjustable blur radius. Browser-based.

**add-text-to-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/add-text-to-image)
Adds custom text overlay to photos with font, size, and colour options. Browser-based.

**add-watermark-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/add-watermark-image)
Adds a text watermark to photos with opacity and position control. Browser-based.

**image-brightness** (https://pdfandimage.com/image-brightness)
Adjusts image brightness and contrast with live preview. Browser-based.

**upscale-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/upscale-image)
AI-powered image upscaler — increases resolution up to 4x. Uses Real-ESRGAN.

**svg-to-png** (https://pdfandimage.com/svg-to-png)
Converts SVG vector files to raster PNG images at specified dimensions. Browser-based.

**image-to-base64** (https://pdfandimage.com/image-to-base64)
Encodes image files to Base64 string representation. Browser-based using FileReader API.

**base64-to-image** (https://pdfandimage.com/base64-to-image)
Decodes Base64 strings back to image files. Browser-based.

**bulk-image-compressor** (https://pdfandimage.com/bulk-image-compressor)
Compresses up to 20 images at once. Output is a ZIP archive. Browser-based.

**gif-to-mp4** (https://pdfandimage.com/gif-to-mp4)
Converts animated GIF files to MP4 video. Uses FFmpeg.wasm (browser-side).

**mp4-to-gif** (https://pdfandimage.com/mp4-to-gif)
Converts MP4 video clips to animated GIF. Uses FFmpeg.wasm (browser-side).

**meme-generator** (https://pdfandimage.com/meme-generator)
Creates memes by adding top/bottom text captions to images. Browser-based.

**png-to-svg** (https://pdfandimage.com/png-to-svg)
Converts raster PNG images to SVG vector format using Potrace. Server-side.

---

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- **PDF processing (client-side):** pdf-lib, PDF.js, jsPDF
- **Image processing (client-side):** Canvas API, browser-image-compression, heic2any, Cropper.js, FFmpeg.wasm
- **OCR:** Tesseract.js (client-side)
- **Server-side conversions:** LibreOffice via Gotenberg Docker container (PDF↔Office formats)
- **Hosting:** Vercel (frontend) + Railway (Gotenberg)
- **CDN:** Cloudflare

---

## Privacy Policy Summary

- Client-side tools: files never leave the user's device
- Server-side tools (PDF-to-Word etc.): files are transmitted over HTTPS, processed, and immediately deleted — never stored
- No user accounts or authentication
- Analytics: Google Analytics 4 (aggregate, anonymized), Microsoft Clarity (heatmaps, anonymized)
- No selling of user data
- Full policy: https://pdfandimage.com/privacy
